scanNote:
Coursebook'ning 'Introduction' (kirish so'z) beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 5.

Bet ikki ustunli, sarlavha yashil harflar bilan: 'Introduction'. Matn o'qituvchilar va o'quvchilarga mo'ljallangan — kitob qanday tuzilgani tushuntiriladi.

⚠⚠ SKANERDA 4-BET YO'Q. Mundarija 2-3-betlarda tugadi, keyingi skaner esa 5-bet. Bet raqamini kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim — aniq '5'. Demak 4-bet skanerga tushmagan.

Kirish matni 5-betda TO'LIQ: chap ustun boshlanadi, o'ng ustun uni davom ettiradi va tugaydi. Ya'ni 4-betda BOShQA narsa bo'lgan (ehtimol bo'sh bet).

⚠⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM TOPILMA: kirish matnida aniq yozilgan — 'The course consists of FIFTEEN UNITS in four modules'.

Bu 159-betdagi (orqa muqova) 'four modules of FOUR UNITS EACH' (= 16 unit) da'vosini KITOBNING O'ZI RAD ETADI.

Endi 15 unit ekani UCH manbadan tasdiqlandi:
   1) bu kirish matni — 'fifteen units'
   2) 2-betdagi mundarija — 'Module 4: Units 13, 14, 15'
   3) modul muqova sahifalari — 'Module 4 (Units 13-15)'

⚠ FOYDALI MA'LUMOT: matnda kurs '70-75 teaching hours' (70-75 dars soati) ga mo'ljallangani aytilgan.

⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK: bu yerda kitob 'the Student's Book' deb atalgan, muqovada esa 'Coursebook'. Ikki nom bir kitobga nisbatan ishlatilgan.

⚠ Bu yerda ham GRAMMAR BOOK tilga olinmagan — hamrohlik qiluvchi materiallar ro'yxatida faqat Teacher's Book, kassetalar/CD, Workbook va Test Booklet bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Introduction: Enterprise 1 Beginner is a complete course for students studying English at beginner level.
exercises.instructionUz: Kirish: Enterprise 1 Beginner — boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tilini o'rganayotgan o'quvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — KITOBNING KIRISh SO'ZI
(Introduction).

  Matn asosan O'QITUVChILARGA
  mo'ljallangan: kitob qanday tuzilgani
  va har bo'lim nima uchun kerakligi
  tushuntiriladi.

  ⚠ Lekin o'quvchi uchun ham foydali —
  kitobdan qanday foydalanishni
  ko'rsatadi.


⚠⚠ SKANERDA 4-BET YO'Q:

  Mundarija 2-3-betlarda tugadi, keyingi
  skaner esa 5-bet.

  ⚠ Bet raqamini kesib kattalashtirib
  tekshirdim — aniq '5'.

  ⚠ Kirish matni 5-betda TO'LIQ (chap
  ustun boshlanadi, o'ng ustun tugatadi).
  Demak 4-betda boshqa narsa bo'lgan,
  ehtimol bo'sh bet.


⚠⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM TOPILMA:

  Kirish matnida ANIQ yozilgan:

     'The course consists of FIFTEEN
      UNITS in four modules and a variety
      of supplementary material,
      including a workbook. In total,
      Enterprise 1 Beginner may be
      covered in 70-75 teaching hours.'

  ⚠ 'FIFTEEN UNITS' = 15 UNIT!

  ⚠⚠ Bu 159-betdagi (orqa muqova)
  'four modules of FOUR UNITS EACH'
  (= 16 unit) da'vosini KITOBNING O'ZI
  RAD ETADI.

  Endi 15 unit ekani UCh manbadan
  tasdiqlandi:
     1) bu kirish matni — 'fifteen units'
     2) 2-betdagi mundarija —
        'Module 4: Units 13, 14, 15'
     3) modul muqova sahifalari —
        'Module 4 (Units 13-15)'

  ⚠ Ya'ni XATO faqat ORQA MUQOVADA.


⚠ FOYDALI MA'LUMOT — DARS SOATI:

  'may be covered in 70-75 teaching
   hours'

  = kursni 70-75 dars soatida o'tish
    mumkin.

  ⚠ Haftada 3 soatdan o'qilsa — taxminan
  24-25 hafta, ya'ni bir o'quv yili.


UNIT TUZILIShI (kirish matnidan):

  1) LEAD-IN sections
     Mavzuga kirish. O'quvchining bilgani
     eslatiladi, yangi so'z va grammatika
     oldindan ko'rsatiladi. Tinglash bilan
     tugaydi.

  2) READING sections
     50-150 so'zli matnlar.
     ⚠ 'reading for gist' = umumiy
        mazmunni tushunish
     ⚠ 'reading for specific information'
        = aniq ma'lumotni topish

  3) LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT sections
     a) Vocabulary — lug'at
        ⚠ KOLLOKATSIYALAR o'rgatiladi:
        so'zlar ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA
        holda yodlanadi.
     b) Grammar — grammatika

  4) READING and LISTENING sections
     Haqiqiy, madaniyatlararo mavzular.

  5) PRONUNCIATION
     Tovushlarni tanish va to'g'ri aytish.
     ⚠ Barcha talaffuz mashqlari
     kassetalarda.

  6) COMMUNICATION sections
     Haqiqiy hayotga o'xshash muloqot:
     taklif qilish, ovqat buyurtma qilish
     va h.k.

  7) WRITING sections
     Yozish. Har vazifa oldindan
     tayyorlanadi va o'qish matni namuna
     bo'ladi.

  8) MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT sections
     Har to'rtinchi unitdan keyin
     takrorlash.

  9) UChTA SARGUZAShT HIKOYASI
     ⚠ 'in a COMIC STRIP format' =
     KOMIKS shaklida!
     Har biri ikki epizodda.

 10) CULTURE CLIPS


⚠⚠ 'COLLOCATIONS' — MUHIM TUShUNChA:

  Kirish matnida: 'A particular feature
  of the book is the teaching of
  COLLOCATIONS, helping students to
  remember vocabulary items as parts of
  SET EXPRESSIONS.'

  ⚠ 'a collocation' = birga keladigan
  so'zlar birikmasi.

  Masalan:
     'MAKE a decision' (do EMAS)
     'DO exercise' (make EMAS)
     'TAKE a break'
     'HAVE breakfast'

  ⚠ Kitob so'zlarni ALOHIDA emas,
  BIRIKMA holda o'rgatishni maqsad
  qilgan — biz ham shu yo'ldan borganmiz.


HAMROHLIK QILUVChI MATERIALLAR:

  a) Teacher's Book — barcha javoblar,
     tavsiyalar va to'rtta test (har biri
     ikki variantda)
  b) Class audio cassettes yoki CDs;
     Student's audio cassettes yoki CDs
  c) Enterprise Beginner Workbook
  d) Enterprise Beginner Test Booklet —
     to'qqizta test, Mid-term test va
     Exit test

  ⚠ Bu yerda ham GRAMMAR BOOK tilga
  OLINMAGAN (159-betdagi ro'yxatda ham
  yo'q edi).


⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK:

  Bu yerda kitob 'the STUDENT'S BOOK'
  deb atalgan, muqovada esa 'COURSEBOOK'.

  ⚠ Ikki nom bir kitobga nisbatan
  ishlatilgan.

  ⚠ Grammar Book muqovasida ham
  'Student's Book' yozilgan edi.


⚠ 'A MID-TERM TEST' va 'AN EXIT TEST':

     'mid-term' = yarim yillik
        ('mid-' = o'rta, 137-betga qarang)
     'an exit test' = yakuniy test
        ('exit' = chiqish)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an introduction = kirish so'z
  a course      = kurs
  extensive     = keng qamrovli
  systematic    = tizimli
  well-integrated = yaxshi uyg'unlashgan
  productive skills = faol ko'nikmalar
                  (gapirish, yozish)
  receptive skills = qabul qiluvchi
                  ko'nikmalar (o'qish,
                  tinglash)
  oral          = og'zaki
  a syllabus    = dastur, reja
  emphasis      = urg'u, e'tibor
  a sub-skill   = qism-ko'nikma
  graded        = darajalangan
  to facilitate = osonlashtirmoq
  acquisition   = o'zlashtirish
  a collocation = so'z birikmasi
  a set expression = barqaror ibora
  gist          = umumiy mazmun
  to scan       = ko'z yugurtirib qidirmoq
  relevant      = tegishli, kerakli
  intonation    = ohang
  to reinforce  = mustahkamlamoq
  supplementary = qo'shimcha
  a comic strip = komiks
  to consolidate = mustahkamlamoq
  invaluable    = bebaho

points.en: The course consists of fifteen units in four modules.
points.uz: Kurs to'rt moduldagi o'n beshta unitdan iborat.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM GAP.

Kitobning O'ZI 'FIFTEEN UNITS' deb yozgan —
bu 159-betdagi orqa muqovadagi 'four modules
of four units each' (= 16) da'vosini RAD
ETADI.

15 unit ekani UCH manbadan tasdiqlandi:
kirish matni, mundarija va modul
muqovalari.

⚠ 'to consist OF' — 'of' bilan (159-bet).

points.en: Enterprise 1 Beginner may be covered in 70-75 teaching hours.
points.uz: Enterprise 1 Beginner ni 70-75 dars soatida o'tish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ FOYDALI MA'LUMOT: haftada 3 soatdan
o'qilsa — taxminan 24-25 hafta, ya'ni bir
o'quv yili.

⚠ 'to cover' bu yerda = o'tmoq, o'rganib
chiqmoq (yopmoq EMAS).

⚠ 'may' = mumkin (ehtimol).

points.en: A particular feature of the book is the teaching of collocations.
points.uz: Kitobning alohida xususiyati — so'z birikmalarini o'rgatish.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'a COLLOCATION' = birga keladigan so'zlar
birikmasi.

  'MAKE a decision' (do EMAS)
  'DO exercise' (make EMAS)
  'TAKE a break'
  'HAVE breakfast'

⚠ Kitob so'zlarni ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA
holda o'rgatishni maqsad qilgan.

⚠ 'a set expression' = barqaror ibora.

points.en: Reading sections consist of 50- to 150-word texts.
points.noteUz:
⚠ '50- to 150-word texts' — defisli qo'shma
sifat, 'word' BIRLIKDA.

⚠ Birinchi '50-' dan keyin defis turibdi —
bu 'suspended hyphen' deyiladi: '50-word
to 150-word' ning qisqartmasi.

⚠ 'reading for GIST' = umumiy mazmunni
tushunish; 'for SPECIFIC INFORMATION' =
aniq ma'lumotni topish.

points.en: Three entertaining adventure stories in a 'comic strip' format, presented in two episodes each.
points.uz: Uchta qiziqarli sarguzasht hikoyasi 'komiks' shaklida, har biri ikki epizodda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 159-betdagi orqa muqovada ham shu gap bor
edi, LEKIN 'comic strip' so'zi YO'Q edi.

⚠ 'a comic strip' = komiks (rasmli hikoya).

⚠ Uchta hikoya: The Loch Ness Monster,
The Expedition, Strange Visitors.

points.en: an easy-to-use Teacher's Book with full answers to the exercises in the Student's Book
points.uz: Student's Book mashqlariga to'liq javoblari bo'lgan qulay Teacher's Book
points.noteUz:
⚠ KICHIK NOMUVOFIQLIK: bu yerda kitob
'the STUDENT'S BOOK' deb atalgan, muqovada
esa 'COURSEBOOK'.

⚠ Grammar Book muqovasida ham 'Student's
Book' yozilgan edi.

⚠ 'easy-to-use' — uch so'zli defisli sifat.

points.en: Enterprise Beginner Test Booklet containing nine write-in tests, a Mid-term test and an Exit test.
points.uz: To'qqizta yozma test, yarim yillik test va yakuniy testdan iborat Test Booklet.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'mid-term' = yarim yillik ('mid-' = o'rta,
137-betdagi 'midnight' kabi).

⚠ 'an exit test' = yakuniy test
('exit' = chiqish).

⚠ 'write-in' = ustiga yoziladigan.

⚠ Bu Workbook'dagi 8 ta Progress Test'dan
BOSHQA narsa — alohida kitobcha.

points.en: ⚠ The Grammar Book is not mentioned here either.
points.uz: ⚠ Bu yerda ham Grammar Book tilga olinmagan.
points.noteUz:
Hamrohlik qiluvchi materiallar ro'yxatida
faqat Teacher's Book, kassetalar/CD,
Workbook va Test Booklet bor.

⚠ 159-betdagi orqa muqova ro'yxatida ham
Grammar Book yo'q edi.

⚠ Bizda esa u bor (77 bet).
